escena: SCENE (staged, cinematic high-impact editorial photograph, a city rooftop at night, cold blue hour just ended): Karo, wearing the ROYAL-BLUE EFEONCE HOODIE, stands on the RIGHT side of the frame, framed from the waist up; her left shoulder is at about 62 % of the frame width and a wide band of empty darkness runs between the left edge of the frame and her body; camera about four meters away at chest height, 85mm f/2, REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS. THE MOMENT: she has just posted a vertical video and lifts her modern frameless phone at shoulder height on the frame-right side of her body; she looks straight into the lens with a playful, confident half-smile, head almost frontal. From the phone's screen one solid vertical column of cool white-azure light shoots straight up into the haze like a searchlight, standing just to the frame-right of her face. Across the city far behind her, dozens of tiny vertical 9:16 glows light up in distant windows and rooftops, the same video now playing everywhere: abstract, unreadable moments, no faces, no products. The column, the skyline and every lit window and glow exist ONLY in the RIGHT 50% of the frame. The LEFT 50% of the frame is an empty, deep dark night sky with soft haze above a completely unlit, black part of the city: no lit windows, no screens, no glows, no lights, no people. No warm light, rich contrast, no logos of any other brand, no readable text.

lecho.objeto: the dark rooftop concrete parapet close to the lens, outside every light

texto.muro: the calm, deep dark space on the left 45% of the frame

llave.fuente: the rising column of cool white light from her phone, just beside her face
llave.lado: to the frame-right of her face, at head height

fondo: the city skyline far behind her, melted into large cold round bokeh
